_comment: Windows executable metadata. This is what File Properties, Details shows,
and what an antivirus or SmartScreen looks at when deciding whether an
unknown binary is worth trusting. An unsigned executable with blank
publisher fields is the exact shape of malware, so filling these in is
worth doing even before there is a certificate to sign with.
CompanyName is the OPERATING NAME, not a legal entity. The imprint says
registration is still in progress and that a placeholder there would be
worse than an honest gap. The same applies here: this file must not claim
a Ltd, GmbH or B.V. that does not exist yet. Update it the day the entity
is issued, and update legal.northwestfalls.com/imprint in the same commit.
Versions are set by CI, not by hand. See internal/ui/README.md.
